text:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_p99 breached in region-usw2 for router-service — p99=1.82s (SLO=0.5s), p95=0.48s. Auto-escalation to oncall-sre. Tags: streaming_stalls, tail_latency, possible-misroute :rotating_light:

sam (oncall-sre): seeing the alert, joining. Investigating traces now. Any customer reports?

lloyd (cs): got two customer tickets - streaming sessions resetting and large response delays for embeddings. Both on-usw2 region.

kara (runtime): traces show a cluster of requests getting repeatedly failed-over between backends, causing long tail and streaming stalls. Looks like routing weight oscillation + prefix hotkey.

anya (infra): checking LB telemetry. I'm seeing a batch of new 5xx from a small subset of hosts (10.10.48.*). Might be a hotpartition in the routing table.

matt (routing): pulling routing table snapshot. There was a policy rollout this morning that changed ingress affinity hash to include tenant_id. Could be seed skew.

sam (oncall-sre): quick mitigation: can we throttle reroutes and force sticky affinity to last-known good for affected keys? We need to stop the eviction/looping before doing full rollback.

kara (runtime): I can add an eager-fallback rule to pin requests that hit the eviction loop to a stable model-variant. Doing a dry-run first. Command: ``/ops route-override --region usw2 --selector "eviction-loop" --action pin:variantA``

devops-bot: Executed dry-run for route-override, no conflicts.

anya (infra): I'm temporarily disabling health-check-based ejection for 10.10.48.0/24 to prevent rapid ejections causing rebalance churn. Patch applied to edge-lb-config 1746423698.

sam (oncall-sre): good. Kara, after you pin, can you also reduce the routing weight shuffle frequency? That will limit oscillation.

kara (runtime): pinned affected keys to variantA (non-quantized, warmed). Also reduced shuffle window from 60s -> 300s. Monitoring now.

matt (routing): confirmed routing table stabilized, hotkey fanout reduced. However we still see p99 ~1.2s, moving down from 1.8s.

lloyd (cs): notified affected customers about mitigation and temporary degraded throughput. They're asking for ETA on full fix.

sam (oncall-sre): root cause hypothesis so far: new affinity hash change + a small set of high-volume tenants created a hot partition. Combined with health-ejection + rapid weight reshuffle caused eviction-looping where requests bounced between a shrinking set of backends, overheating KV caches and causing streaming stalls.

matt (routing): logs: ``WARN router: handoff_attempts=5 key=tenant:8421 host=10.10.48.3 reason=ejection``; multiple hosts got ejected then re-added in <1m windows. That aligns with eviction loop.

kara (runtime): telemetry: streaming stall traces show repeated #send_fragment -> #recv_ready gaps of 400-800ms during handoff cycles. Example trace id: trace-usw2-0a3b.

anya (infra): rolling back the health-ejection policy to previous thresholds for usw2 (threshold from 5%->15% failure rate) to avoid aggressive ejection. Patch 1746423901 queued, will roll in 60s.

sam (oncall-sre): agree. Also schedule a canary rollback of the affinity hash rollout to 2% to validate behavior. Matt, can you prepare rollback plan?

matt (routing): preparing rollback: will revert the affinity flag and run in canary for tenant prefixes in a control group. Plan: revert -> wait 3m -> observe p95/p99 -> promote. If stable, promote global.

devops-bot: Canary rollback job queued: job-id=rbk-1746423720. Estimated runtime 2m.

kara (runtime): monitoring graphs: p95 steady ~0.35s, p99 trending to 0.48s after pin + reduced shuffle. Streaming session reset rate down 80%.

sam (oncall-sre): good signs. Keep rollback paused until health-ejection rollback lands. We don't want to flip two variables at once.

anya (infra): health-ejection thresholds rolled back. Confirmed hosts rejoining without churn.

matt (routing): initiating canary rollback now to control group (rbk-1746423720).

/devops-bot/: Canary rollback completed successfully for control group.

matt (routing): p99 now 0.52s; p95 0.34s. Slightly above SLO but within transient. Continuing to observe for 10m before global promote.

lloyd (cs): customers updated. one customer asked about RMAs for dropped streams; offering temporary increase in burst quotas while we stabilize.

sam (oncall-sre): action items for post-incident: 1) revert affinity rollout and re-evaluate hash function to avoid tenant-id bias; 2) add rate-limiting on prefix-heavy tenants and a hotkey throttle path; 3) change LB ejection to exponential backoff instead of immediate re-add; 4) create an alert for eviction-loop pattern (repeated ejection+readd within 2m).

kara (runtime): I'll own item 2 and 4. Will add a streaming stall per-trace metric and eviction-loop detector.

anya (infra): I'll own item 3 and coordinate a safe rollout for health-ejection algorithm.

matt (routing): I'll investigate hash seed skew and propose a deterministic fallback that avoids creating small hot partitions.

sam (oncall-sre): final status: mitigation in place, p99 falling to ~0.5s, streaming resets minimal. Incident severity de-escalated to P2. We'll keep this thread open until full postmortem scheduled. Great work team :thumbsup:

lloyd (cs): I'll keep sending customer comms and log followups.

sam (oncall-sre): scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow 0900 PT. Invite: @kara @anya @matt @lloyd.

incident-bot: Incident auto-closed (transient-stable) — re-open if regressions observed.
